text: I use the free version and I really like it. It focuses on people with ADHD too which helps me a lot to actually keep up with everything. It has plenty of things in 1 app which is very nice. The only thing that bothers me a little is that the Dutch version (which I use) have weird and too literal translations which makes certain things not make sense, that's not so professional and it distracts me. That is one of the reasons I don't want to pay for the app, sadly enough.
author: Zana Recica
developer_reply: Hi Zana, we're so happy you like our daily planner! We truly appreciate your support and feedback. We’ll work on improving the Dutch translation to make it more natural. If you enjoy our ADHD planner, we’d be so grateful if you could support our young startup with a 5-star review. Your support helps us improve the app. Thanks!
